name: @robinhood-stock-market/agentkit-relayer
description: Trusted-signer relayer bridging World AgentKit human-verification to Robinhood Chain. Verifies AgentKit signatures, checks AgentBook humanId with three-state fault handling, enforces its own replay nonce, and signs a raw-hash attestation. Does not call placeBet() — that integration is out of scope for this round.
